name: Awakened Apparatus
text: Refresh: Discard 1 power from this machine. If it has no power on it, return it to the collection.
sun_challenge: <f>Lights flicker on above.</f> Discard 1 power from this machine. [right_arrow] Until the end of the turn, all areas are illuminated.
mountain_challenge: Move 1 power from this machine to the machine with the least power.
crest_challenge: <f>Structural collapse!</f> Discard 1 power from this machine. [right_arrow] Suffer 1 fatigue.

name: Campfire Remains
text: Refresh: Discard 1 ember from this feature. If it has no embers on it, return it to the collection.
sun_challenge: <f>The wind douses some of the embers.</f> Discard 1 ember from this feature.
mountain_challenge: Add 1 [harm] to a being. If this cleared that being, suffer 2 fatigue.
crest_challenge: <f>You breathe in some of the residual smoke.</f> Suffer 1 fatigue and discard 1 ember from this feature.
